rules.description: Verify MaxDate is within allowable publication lag and values are non-negative (and within [0, 100] for unemployment rates) for active recurring ABS series

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, NumPlaces, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(LifeExpectancy_|UnemploymentRate_|dc/nm9hcklgg5zb3)') OR (regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_Person') AND NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '(Condition|6To9Years)'))
params.condition: CAST(SUBSTR(MaxDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 4) AND total_svs = 266 AND NumPlaces >= 1 AND MinValue >= 0 AND (NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '^UnemploymentRate_') OR MaxValue <= 100)

rules.description: Verify MaxDate and non-negative values for 5-year Census health conditions, biennial household income survey, and historical state age-bracket series

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, NumPlaces, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE regexp_matches(StatVar, '(Condition|^Weekly_|6To9Years)')
params.condition: CAST(SUBSTR(MaxDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 2016 AND total_svs = 587 AND NumPlaces >= 1 AND MinValue >= 0
